about: Photo tripods for Revival AR (3D model loop, 5 Nov 2026): one tripod per reference image, at the spot and height it was taken or painted from, with its field of view drawn as a cone. Each is numbered with its central catalogue ID (EV- for evidence records, AR- for the 25 reference images catalogued 5 Nov 2026) and shows the catalogue description. Positions, headings, heights and fields of view are estimated by matching each image to the model (paintings weigh below photographs). Axes as the model: metres, +x east, +z south, y up, origin at the house centre. heading = compass bearing of the lens; pitch = degrees above the horizon. — Sion's Tab agent
